messages:
maria: hey folks, short notice — need someone to cover tonight 11:30pm-3:30am PT. kid is out, sorry for the scramble.

maria: main risk: nightly batch job at 02:00 can spike model queue & cause latency blips. runbook link: https://redwood.company/runbooks/oncall-overnight

maria: quick handoff notes:
- watch /dash/oncall and /dash/model-latency
- if queue length > 500 or p95 latency > 850ms escalate
- prewarm command below (runs token-prefetch + kv warm):
```
redwood prewarm --model gpt-4o-mini --tokens 200000 --duration 15m
```

sam: I can take it, will shadow with alex for ~40m then continue solo. ping me at 23:05 PT.

jin: FYI there's a canary rollout at 01:45 that touches quantized kernels. watch 5xx rate in /alerts/model-errors (thresholds are set but still new).

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled job batch-20260318-02 triggers at 02:00 (expected runtime ~12m).

alex: I can join the first 30-40 minutes for a quick pairing handoff, then sam takes over. please DM me if you can't find the runbook.

sam: thanks — quick note: if latency spikes, toggle routing to fallback-lowcost route: policy `fallback-lowcost` -> v2-small for <1h.

maria: thanks @sam and @alex, I left a short checklist in the runbook page too. :thumbsup:

jin: Sam — do you want me to open a live shadow session for logs/console so you can poke during the first hour?

sam: yes please, that'd be helpful. thx!

jin: done. ssh session: https://ssh.redwood.company/session/abcd1234 (expires in 1h). set to read-only for safety.

maria: final note in case of cache thrash:
```
If cache miss rate > 70%:
  1) run: redwood prewarm --model gpt-4o-mini --tokens 200000 --duration 15m
  2) monitor /dash/model-latency and /dash/cache-hits
  3) if errors persist > 10m, escalate to oncall lead @alex and open an incident stub
```

sam: got it. I'll post a short handback at 03:30 PT with queue length, p95, and any actions taken.

alex: great — remember to ack alerts and add a one-line root cause to the alert response channel if you take any action.

sam: will do. thanks again everyone, appreciate the cover.
